description: Land Title Settlement Department - Claims to property of Intestate in Homagama D/S Division, & other properties
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically notices calling for claims to intestate property under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land registration information including cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and certificate of title numbers. The content focuses on property ownership claims and land title registration processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
